name: SecureBank (lab target)
description: Fictional banking app used as the PENT-03 analysis target. It performs TLS with certificate pinning (OkHttp CertificatePinner + a Network Security Config) and basic root detection, so it exercises every stage of the pipeline: frida-server, system CA, proxy and the universal unpinning hook.
defenses: OkHttp CertificatePinner (SHA-256 pin on the API host)
root detection via su-path probes and RootBeer
notes: No APK is committed to this repo (os-lab rule: do not commit binaries you don't own). Build SecureBank from your own source, or point the pipeline at a public intentionally-vulnerable app for practice (see target/README.md) and widen scope with OSLAB_EXTRA_PACKAGES.
